title: SecureObs — DevSecOps Security Observatory Platform
description: Solo-designed and production-deployed multi-tenant security SaaS that unifies seven open-source scanners (Semgrep, Gitleaks, Trivy, Bandit, ESLint-security, OSV-Scanner, Checkov) into one triage dashboard, with cross-tool canonical deduplication, SARIF export, and a CI/CD build gate that fails pipelines on unresolved blocking findings.
highlights: Credential-free IaC attack-path engine: statically parses Terraform, constructs typed Azure resource graph, chains misconfigurations into ranked attack paths via pluggable rule engine (Cytoscape visualization)
Defense-in-depth tenant isolation: app-layer authorization + PostgreSQL FORCE row-level security under restricted non-owner DB role, validated by Testcontainers regression tests
Zero-config GitHub App connectors executing scans in ephemeral sandboxed Azure Container Instances with short-lived tokens and auto-provisioned project-scoped API keys
Secured with Entra ID OAuth 2.1 (PKCE), SHA-256-hashed API keys, Azure Key Vault via Managed Identity, OpenTelemetry, security headers, layered rate limiting, and OWASP WebGoat canaries
role: Solo founder & engineer — full-stack, security architecture, infrastructure

title: Microsoft Sentinel Cloud Security & Detection Lab
description: Detection-engineering lab with KQL analytics rules, incident investigation workflows, and cloud-security detection scenarios mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Includes SOAR-automated response workflows and Terraform-deployed infrastructure-as-code.

title: DevSecOps CI/CD Security Gates
description: Reference CI/CD pipeline integrating SAST (Semgrep/SonarQube), DAST (OWASP ZAP), secrets detection (Gitleaks), SCA (Trivy/OSV-Scanner), and IaC scanning (Checkov) with hard build gates blocking promotion on unresolved high-severity findings.

title: Azure Secure Landing Zone Baseline
description: Infrastructure-as-Code implementation of Azure landing zone security best practices: network segmentation, Azure Policy enforcement, RBAC configuration, centralized logging to Log Analytics, and compliance monitoring.

title: Secure API Gateway Pattern
description: Production-ready API gateway with OWASP API Top 10 mitigations: JWT authentication, rate limiting, request validation, SQL injection prevention, XSS protection, and comprehensive audit logging.

title: Threat Model: Multi-Tenant SaaS CRM
description: Comprehensive threat model for a multi-tenant CRM using STRIDE methodology: data flow diagrams, trust boundaries, threat identification, risk assessment, and prioritized mitigations with implementation guidance.

title: Cloud Security Hardening Checklist
description: CIS Benchmark-aligned security hardening guide for Azure and AWS with automated verification scripts for continuous compliance monitoring.
